Name: Rotom Phone Mod
Author: PointDexter24
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52522/52522-1789673840-810446130.png[/img]
Another mod of my creation—and this one took quite a while to finish, mainly because I combined it with another project of mine: [b]PKO (Prairie King Online)[/b].
This mod gives you your very own [b]Rotom Phone[/b], packed with features designed to make your time in Stardew Valley even more enjoyable. It works with or without the [b]Pelipper Town Mod[/b], although I highly recommend using both together to get the full experience.
Watch movies, listen to music, play games, and more while waiting for shops to open, NPCs to become available, or events to begin. The mod also includes several [b]time-speed options[/b], letting you slow things down and enjoy these activities without feeling like the entire in-game day is disappearing.
The Rotom Phone also features [b]PKO — Prairie King Online[/b], allowing you to play [b]Journey of the Prairie King online[/b], play alongside your favorite NPCs, or team up with random NPCs.
You can even purchase the [b]Battle Pass[/b] and earn rewards while playing.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52522/52522-1791892898-893984708.png[/img]
[heading][size=3][color=#D4D4D8] [/color][/size][color=#d4d4d8][size=2]🎮 How It Works[/size][/color][/heading]
[list]
[*]Open the [b]Rotom Phone (default key: R)[/b] in-game to access its app-style menu and Pelipper Town utilities from one place.[/*]
[*]The phone gives you quick access to features such as [b]Pokémon Team, Pokémon Storage, Pokédex, Online Services, Poké Radar, Pokémon Alerts, Poké Memorial, Calendar, Weather Forecast, and Rotom TV[/b].[/*]
[*]Some apps are grouped into folders to keep the phone organized. Open a folder to access the apps inside it.[/*]
[*]The [b]Pokémon Team[/b] section lets you quickly view information about the Pokémon currently in your party.[/*]
[*][b]Pokémon Storage[/b] provides a convenient shortcut to Pelipper Town’s Pokémon storage system without needing to manually travel to or open its usual interface.[/*]
[*]The [b]Poké Radar[/b] detects nearby [b]wild Pokémon[/b] and helps you see which Pokémon are currently appearing in your area.[/*]
[*][b]Pokémon Alerts[/b] notifies you about useful Pokémon-related events and activity, helping you keep track of important things without constantly checking them yourself.[/*]
[*]The [b]Poké Memorial[/b] provides access to the mod’s Farm Nuzlocke features, including starting, ending, or restarting a Farm Nuzlocke when applicable.[/*]
[*]The [b]Calendar[/b] gives you quick access to the Stardew Valley calendar directly from your phone.
Rotom TV gives you another convenient way to watch and access useful in-game TV content directly from your phone.[/*]
[*]Where possible, the Rotom Phone uses [b]Pelipper Town’s existing systems and menus[/b] instead of replacing them with completely separate versions.[/*]
[*]The Rotom Phone is designed to act as a central hub, so most of the things you regularly check while playing Pelipper Town are only a few taps away. [/*]
[*]Upload your own music, or connect your Spotify account (not advertising, it's just, it's my personal music platform) to play music.[/*]
[*][b]Just download a movie, drop it into the designated folder, and watch it straight from your Rotom Phone without alt-tabbing or taking your eyes off your farm[/b].[/*]
[*]Roms are not included in this mod, so any ROMs you choose to install and play through the emulator are entirely your own responsibility.[/*]
[/list]Basically, open your phone, check what you need, jump straight into the feature you want, and spend less time digging through menus while playing.
[b]Take note:[/b] Some apps are not available immediately. You will need to talk to certain NPCs around town and meet specific conditions to unlock them.

 Also included in this mod is another project of mine: [b]Journey of the Prairie King Online![/b]
So, what's new?
[list]
[*][b]No More Power-Ups — Choose Your Mercenary![/b]
Power-ups are a thing of the past! Choose your mercenary, each equipped with a unique special ability to help you conquer the Wild West.[/*]
[*][b]Every Mercenary Has a Story[/b]
Each mercenary comes with their own lore, personality, and special ability. Find the one that suits your playstyle![/*]
[*][b]Play Online with NPCs![/b]
Choose any NPC to join you on your adventure, or queue up solo and get matched with random NPCs.[/*]
[*][b]Introducing PKP Currency and the Battle Pass![/b]
Earn PKP currency and spend it on an exclusive Battle Pass. It might cost you a pretty penny, but I assure you, the rewards are far greater than the gold you'll spend![/*]
[*][b]Practice in Offline Mode![/b]
Want to master your mercenary's abilities before heading into battle? Play offline, experiment with different mercenaries, and sharpen your skills without the pressure.[/*]
[/list][b]Whether you want to brave the Wild West with familiar faces, team up with unexpected allies, or take on the challenge at your own pace...[/b]


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52522/52522-1791893058-1483820045.png[/img]

[color=#d4d4d8]⚠️ Notes[/color]


[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]📦 Place the [b]Pelipper Town Rotom Phone[/b] folder inside your Stardew Valley [/color]

[code]Mods[/code][color=#D4D4D8] folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]⚠️ Make sure you already have [b]SMAPI[/b] installed. [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] and [b]Pelipper Town 1.2.0 or later[/b]   are  optional.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]💾 Back up your save before using the mod, especially before making major changes to your Pokémon.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]✅ Once in-game, press [b]R[/b] to open the [b]Rotom Phone[/b] and get started.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]⚙️ You can change the editor hotkey through [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] or the mod's [/color]

[code]config.json[/code][color=#D4D4D8] if you prefer a different key.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
